cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our team.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Collaborate with our engineering team to develop cutting-edge products.
Identify efficient production methods and recommend materials and equipment for optimal results.
Source new materials and parts, ensuring they meet design specifications.
Analyze manufacturing processes to improve cost-effectiveness and quality.
Develop product specifications, engineering tests, and quality plans.
Oversee sample model fabrication and refinement before mass production.
Conduct performance tests to ensure designs meet or exceed requirements.
Liaise with sales, customer service, and manufacturing teams for seamless production transitions.
Assist in marketing efforts by reporting on design performance.
Estimate costs for new products and revisions, providing detailed backup data.
Collaborate with manufacturing to create Bills of Materials and labor costing.
Provide essential information to upper management for pricing and marketing strategies.
Act as an effective problem solver, anticipating potential issues and long-term impacts of design decisions.
Maintain clear communication with customers, suppliers, and overseas partners.
Contribute to organizational projects.
Attend company events and occasional sales meetings or trainings.
Support other departments with projects and overflow work as directed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
2+ Years of experience in Bill of Materials, labor costing, and engineering drawings preparation.
Proficiency in Solidworks software.
Strong understanding of plastic or die-cast part design, including material selection and mold design.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pro-Engineer and product design.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0083.responsibilities:
Collaborate with our engineering team to develop cutting-edge products. Identify efficient production methods and recommend materials and equipment for optimal results. Source new materials and parts, ensuring they meet design specifications. Analyze manufacturing processes to improve cost-effectiveness and quality. Develop product specifications, engineering tests, and quality plans. Oversee sample model fabrication and refinement before mass production. Conduct performance tests to ensure designs meet or exceed requirements. Liaise with sales, customer service, and manufacturing teams for seamless production transitions. Assist in marketing efforts by reporting on design performance. Estimate costs for new products and revisions, providing detailed backup data. Collaborate with manufacturing to create Bills of Materials and labor costing. Provide essential information to upper management for pricing and marketing strategies. Act as an effective problem solver, anticipating potential issues and long-term impacts of design decisions. Maintain clear communication with customers, suppliers, and overseas partners.
Additional Responsibilities: Contribute to organizational projects. Attend company events and occasional sales meetings or trainings. Support other departments with projects and overflow work as directed.
cond_0083.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Bill of Materials, labor costing, and engineering drawings preparation.
Deep knowledge of Solidworks software.
Advanced knowledge of plastic or die-cast part design, including material selection and mold design.
Exceptional communication skills and ability to work independently.
Proven track record with Pro-Engineer and product design.
cond_0083.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

cond_0222.intro: We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our team at [Company name masked] in [Location masked]. In this role, you'll work closely with engineering, sales, manufacturing, and other teams to take products from concept through to final rollout.
cond_0222.responsibilities:
Collaborate daily with the engineering team to develop new products.
Identify efficient production methods and recommend materials and equipment.
Source new materials and parts, ensuring they meet design specifications.
Analyze manufacturing processes to improve cost-effectiveness and quality.
Develop product specifications, engineering tests, and quality plans.
Oversee sample model fabrication and refinement before mass production.
Conduct performance tests to ensure designs meet requirements.
Stay in regular contact with sales, customer service, and manufacturing teams to support smooth production transitions.
Assist in marketing efforts by reporting on design performance.
Estimate costs for new products and revisions, providing detailed backup data.
Work with manufacturing to create Bills of Materials and labor costing.
Communicate findings and recommendations to upper management to support pricing and marketing decisions.
Anticipate potential issues and consider long-term impacts of design decisions, raising concerns early.
Maintain ongoing communication with customers, suppliers, and overseas partners.
Contribute to organizational projects.
Attend company events and occasional sales meetings or trainings.
Support other departments with projects and overflow work as directed.
cond_0222.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
2+ Years of experience with Bill of Materials, labor costing, and engineering drawings preparation.
Proficiency in SolidWorks software.
Strong understanding of plastic or die-cast part design, including material selection and mold design.
Clear, confident communication skills and ability to stay in regular contact with internal teams and external partners.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pro-Engineer and product design.

cond_0289.intro: We are looking for a Product Engineer to join our team.
cond_0289.responsibilities:
Collaborate with our engineering team to develop cutting-edge products.
Identify efficient production methods and recommend materials and equipment for optimal results.
Source new materials and parts, ensuring they meet design specifications.
Analyze manufacturing processes to improve cost-effectiveness and quality.
Develop product specifications, engineering tests, and quality plans.
Oversee sample model fabrication and refinement before mass production.
Conduct performance tests to ensure designs meet or exceed requirements.
Liaise with sales, customer service, and manufacturing teams for seamless production transitions.
Assist in marketing efforts by reporting on design performance.
Estimate costs for new products and revisions, providing detailed backup data.
Collaborate with manufacturing to create Bills of Materials and labor costing.
Provide essential information to upper management for pricing and marketing strategies.
Act as an effective problem solver, anticipating potential issues and long-term impacts of design decisions.
Maintain clear communication with customers, suppliers, and overseas partners.
Contribute to organizational projects.
Attend company events and occasional sales meetings or trainings.
Support other departments with projects and overflow work as directed.
cond_0289.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering.
2+ Years of experience in Bill of Materials, labor costing, and engineering drawings preparation.
Proficiency in Solidworks software.
Strong understanding of plastic or die-cast part design, including material selection and mold design.
Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Pro-Engineer and product design.
cond_0289.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Identify efficient production methods and recommend materials and equipment for optimal results. Source new materials and parts, ensuring they meet design specifications. Analyze manufacturing processes to improve cost-effectiveness and quality. Develop product specifications, engineering tests, and quality plans. Oversee sample model fabrication and refinement before mass production. Conduct performance tests to ensure designs meet or exceed requirements. Liaise with sales, customer service, and manufacturing teams for seamless production transitions. Assist in marketing efforts by reporting on design performance. Estimate costs for new products and revisions, providing detailed backup data. Collaborate with manufacturing to create Bills of Materials and labor costing. Provide essential information to upper management for pricing and marketing strategies. Act as an effective problem solver, anticipating potential issues and long-term impacts of design decisions. Maintain clear communication with customers, suppliers, and overseas partners. Additional Responsibilities: Contribute to organizational projects. Attend company events and occasional sales meetings or trainings. Support other departments with projects and overflow work as directed.
cond_0516.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 2 years of experience with Bill of Materials, labor costing, and engineering drawings preparation, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of Solidworks software.
Background in plastic or die-cast part design, including material selection and mold design.
Ability to communicate effectively and work independently.
Some experience with Pro-Engineer and product design is helpful; willingness to develop these skills is welcome.
cond_0516.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0516.workplace_support: Our workplace is designed to support different ways of working and different stages of life and career. We provide flexibility so employees can do their best work while balancing collaboration, wellbeing, and personal responsibilities.
